notes.title: Bots OBT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/e1a5d020c8a8a976e2ad75fbc2c927ae983f119d.png[/img]

Sup, boys!
The open beta-test for bots has started!
For now, the bots can only run and shoot with automatic rifles. They can't operate machinery or shoot with RPGs.
Cheats are canceled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/9cf81e79c2ed246e29fa80689a23963ccdddb59a.png[/img]
This is where you adjust the number of bots.
12 means that bots will fill the teams up to 6x6.
If your game is lagging too much, I recommend reducing the number of bots.

Have fun 😆

notes.title: Repair & Medikit
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/1c29f6836a956624d1ab3296f3475588f82d4027.png[/img]
[h3]
Have you ever been upset you almost killed that tank but the player has repaired it to 100%?
And you can't even heal yourself to 50%?
Balance has changed!
[b]Now Repair will restore only 50% of vehicle's health, and the Medikit will heal 100 hp[/b]
(it wouldn't be 100% if you have the Armor)
Also Repair/Heal is not instant anymore! It takes some time to perform the action.
[/h3]

notes.title: Straight hands Cooldown
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/50a0903e1dc57d893fc09c285dba1ac3c22956ab.png[/img]
[h3]Good news everyone!

Consumable cooldown is fixed with straight hands.
Everything has a different cooldown now. Ka-50 is prepairing for 3 minutes, and the Medikits are 10 seconds for instance.

+ There is an indication of using the Medikits and Repair now. It's green effect. You won't miss it.

Good hunt![/h3]

notes.title: Cooldown for the Items
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/fc31473e65fe74278a114b50498fd041fa1756a3.png[/img]
[h3][b]ATTENTION![/b]

Now there's a cooldown for the consumable items (medikits, repairs, etc.) - [b]10 seconds.[/b]

Circle shaped indicator with a lock is telling you when the item is ready to use.

[b]FOR NOW[/b] it's made with my butt, so the indicator will be shown even if you didn't used the item (you attempted to use the Repair while not in the vehicle, for instance). And even if there's nothing in the item slot at all.
Don't mind it. It will be fixed with the straight hands soon. But for now we just needed the fast way to show the readiness of the items.

Good hunt![/h3]

notes.title: Right Place, Right Time!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/a047692e4f871e4e0d9f8550392cd140b94782df.png[/img]
[h3]Fighters!
If you If you once again hear the sound of silence on the servers... maybe you've come at the wrong time.
As practice has shown, [u]the most active time is[/u]:

[b]13:00 - 18:00 GMT[/b] (or 5:00am - 10:00am PST)(or 16:00 - 21:00 Moscow)

It doesn't mean you will not find someone to play with in other time.
But the maximum number of players on the servers is at the specified period of time.[/h3]

notes.title: Cut the Chatter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/f4e5f3c155c8ce51271a62023e978cfd1936b060.png[/img]
[h3]You've came [b]to play[/b] and [b]chat[/b] with your fiends, but the soy boy from the opposite team keep flooding the chat with his bullcrap?
Now you are able [b]to Shut him Up[/b] and [b]not see his messages in the chat.[/b]
All you have to do is click the icon in the players list.
[b]It can be made:[/b]
[list]
[*] After your death and before you click the resurrection button.
[*] Pressing ESC key (it will bring up the menu and unlock the mouse cursor), and holding the TAB key (it will show the players list)
[/list]
Good hunting![/h3]

notes.title: Bugfix: increased the amount of experience and silver for the battle, fixed bugs
Game released in early access! Discount in honor of the release - 25%!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are pleased to present you the first working version of our game. From now on, we will conduct the necessary improvements and release updates that will bring the game from the "Early Access" stage to the full release!
Do not forget to write your reviews about the game and share your impressions in the discussions.

notes.title: Release to early access: 02/27/2019!
notes.notes:
Dear players and all who expect our game in the early access!
We practically finished work on the version of the game for early access, but we had to postpone the release date from February 22 to 27, because some things we did not have time to do to this day. Now we confidently declare that the game will be released to early access on February 27 - and this is accurate information!
We will be glad to see everyone in the game!
